rows.detail: 'responds to clarification requests 1 to 6', but ADD-01/Q4 adds an obligation (ADD-01:Q4): 'The geotechnical report in the data room is provided for information. Bidders shall satisfy themselves as to ground conditions.'

ADD-01/3.1 adds an obligation (ADD-01:3.1); the summary does not mention it: 'The attendance record is held by the Authority. A Bidder that considers its attendance to have been incorrectly recorded shall notify the Authority through the Portal within five (5) Working Days of this Addendum.'
ADD-01/AppA/para1 replaces VOL-IV:F4-A; the summary does not mention it: 'Form 4-A is reissued below to add the acknowledgement of Addenda at paragraph 1. Bidders shall use this version.'
ADD-02:7.2 states 'Failure to submit Form 4-G shall render the Proposal non-responsive.'; the summary says only 'adds Form 4-G'

'reinstates Volume I Clause 8.6', but ADD-02/9.1 reinstates it in an amended form: 'The Bidder shall submit a Local Content Certificate issued by the competent authority evidencing a local content ratio of not less than thirty-five per cent (35%) for the construction phase. Failure …' (as issued: 'The Bidder shall submit a Local Content Certificate issued by the competent authority evidencing a local content ratio of not less than thirty per cent (30%) f…')
ADD-02:9.1 states 'Failure to submit the certificate shall render the Proposal non-responsive.'; the summary says only 'reinstates Volume I Clause 8.6'

ADD-02/T1-1-rev/note(2) amends VOL-I:11.2; the summary does not mention it: '(2) The combined score weighting stated in Volume I Clause 11.2 is amended to sixty-five per cent (65%) technical and thirty-five per cent (35%) commercial.'
ADD-02/5.2 adds an obligation (VOL-II:S3); the summary does not mention it: 'Bidders shall reflect the amended limit in the process design submitted under Volume II Section 3.'
ADD-02/9.2 ends the effect of ADD-01:4.2; the summary does not mention it: 'Section 4.2 of Addendum No. 1 ceases to have effect.'
ADD-03:8.1 states 'A Proposal that quotes an Availability Payment exceeding this amount shall be rejected.'; the summary says only 'inserts a new Volume I Clause 10.5'

'responds to clarification requests 15 to 20', but ADD-03/Q16 amends VOL-II:6.1: 'No. In Volume II Clause 6.1, ‘a permanently manned central control room’ is deleted and ‘a central control room manned between 06:00 and 22:00 daily’ is substituted. Volume II Clause 8.3 is unchanged.'

'responds to clarification requests 15 to 20', but ADD-03/Q17 adds an obligation (VOL-I:8.5): 'No. Only a reference project for which the consortium member itself was responsible for design, construction or operation will be considered. A reference project of an affiliate will be disregarded.'

ADD-03/2.3 amends ADD-01:AppA/proposal-due-date; the summary does not mention it: 'In the revised Form 4-A at Appendix A to Addendum No. 1, the entry against ‘Proposal Due Date’, which was not updated by that Addendum, is corrected to read ‘10 December 2026, 14:00 Riyadh time’.'

ADD-03/3.2 amends VOL-I:5.2; the summary does not mention it: 'In Volume I Clause 5.2, ‘Requests received after that time will not be answered.’ is deleted and ‘Requests received after 14:00 Riyadh time on the last day for submission will not be answered.’ is substituted.'

ADD-03/8.2 renumbers VOL-I:10.5, VOL-I:10.6; the summary does not mention it: 'Existing Volume I Clauses 10.5 and 10.6 are renumbered 10.6 and 10.7 respectively. A reference to Clause 10.5 or Clause 10.6 in Volumes I to V or in Addenda Nos. 1 and 2, including in the response to clarification request 14 in Addendum No…'
ADD-03/9.2 ends the effect of ADD-02:Q13; the summary does not mention it: 'The response to clarification request 13 in Addendum No. 2 is superseded.'
ADD-03/11.2 adds an obligation (ADD-03:11.2); the summary does not mention it: 'Bidders shall reflect the amended flow in the hydraulic design submitted under Volume II Section 4.'
ADD-03/12.2 adds an obligation (VOL-I:9.4); the summary does not mention it: 'Each member of the Bidder shall give the sixth declaration in its Form 4-C. Volume I Clause 9.4 applies.'
